prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — it depends on what you need (branding vs. performance marketing vs. social, industry experience, budget, whether you need local or national reach, etc.). To help quickly:

Quick starters (well-known KC firms)
- Barkley — large, independent creative and branding agency; strong at integrated campaigns and creative strategy.
- VML/VMLY&R — global digital, brand experience and tech-driven work; good for digitally complex or large-scale brand programs.

How to choose the right one
- Define goals: brand awareness, lead generation, sales, retention, etc.
- Look for relevant case studies and measurable results in your industry.
- Check team seniority and whether they’ll manage your account day-to-day.
- Ask about reporting/analytics and how they measure ROI.
- Get references and a clear scope/fee structure up front.

If you tell me:
- what kind of marketing you need (SEO, PPC, social, creative/branding, B2B, e‑commerce, etc.),
- your budget range,
- and whether you want a local boutique or a large national agency,

I’ll give a tailored shortlist of Kansas City agencies that match your needs.
